card.name: Verb after "should be" in instructions
card.fires_on: The word right after "should" or "should be" in label instructions, mainly "be" in "area of application should be limited" and "inspected" in "parenteral drug products should be inspected visually".

modes.label: Inspect before use
modes.description: The word "inspected" after "Parenteral drug products should be" in dosage and administration text.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Parenteral drug products should be<< inspected>> visually for particulate matter and discolor

modes.label: Limit application area
modes.description: The word "be" after "area of application should" in topical gel instructions.
modes.example: Testosterone gel 1.62% should only be applied to the upper arms and shoulders. The area of application should<< be>> limited to the area that will be covered
